{"category_edits":[{"category":"embedding_representation","rationale":"Normalize nonpadding input embeddings to approximately sqrt(d) norm before the existing dropout to reduce input-scale variation and GRU gate saturation. Preserve padding zeros, candidate embeddings, scoring, topology, loss, and optimizer. All four dataset models use this change; the generated predictor imports the same updated model class, so no writer change is needed.","edits":[{"find":"    def aggregate_states(self, out: torch.Tensor, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
","replace":"    def input_embeddings(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.item_emb(seq)
        scale = math.sqrt(self.hidden_units) / torch.sqrt(
            emb.square().sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-8
        )
        return (emb * scale).masked_fill(seq.eq(0).unsqueeze(-1), 0.0)

    def aggregate_states(self, out: torch.Tensor, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
"},{"find":"    def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
","replace":"    def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.input_embeddings(seq))
"},{"find":"    def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
","replace":"    def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):
        emb = self.dropout(self.input_embeddings(seq))
"}]}],"change_summary":"Normalize only input item embeddings in training and inference, preserving zero padding and unchanged scoring embeddings for each of the four independent category models."}
